channel.title: The Grant Desk - next 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: next 30 days, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: Khoj x Mozilla Foundation: Counterstructures Residency 2026 (Delhi)
item.description: Khoj International Artists' Association in collaboration with Mozilla Foundation · deadline 13 Sep 2026 · Mozilla's Creative Futures: Counterstructures programme publishes USD 2,500 per resident (USD 2,000 stipend plus a USD 500 materials budget), along with weekly in-person work sessions, guest lectures from practitioners across art, technology and community design, and publication of the finished project in the collective documentation report. CAVEAT: neither the Khoj call page nor the Mozilla application form restates a figure for this six-week Delhi edition, and the published package covers the ten-week format, so confirm the amount with Khoj before applying. No application fee.

item.title: 6 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Guggenheim Fellowship 2027
    https://www.gf.org/program/how-to-apply/
    John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Variable cash grant sized to the applicant's proposed budget and needs; the Foundation does not publish a fixed figure or range, and recent awards have typically run into the tens of thousands of US dollars. Roughly 175 to 200 fellowships are awarded each year across more than 50 fields. The Foundation charges no application fee and has no affiliated application consultants.
  • Kluge Fellowships at the Library of Congress 2027
    https://www.loc.gov/programs/john-w-kluge-center/chairs-fellowships/fellowships/kluge-fellowships/
    John W. Kluge Center, Library of Congress · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Stipend of USD 5,000 per month for a residency of four to eleven months, so USD 20,000 to USD 55,000 depending on the tenure awarded. Twelve Kluge Fellowships are awarded each year. Stipends are paid monthly by electronic transfer to a U.S. bank account. No application fee, no participation fee.
  • Normsy: Social Media Measurement Methods Incubator RFP
    https://normsy.ai/labs/openrfp
    Normsy (a project of Civic Health Project) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · USD 1,000 awarded to each of the top 5 proposals, plus up to USD 20,000 to fund R&D and/or testing with one selected partner individual or team. Preference for budgets where at least 50 percent goes to research costs (survey respondents, LLM or X API credits). No application fee.
  • BOLD Fellow, British Open-ended Learning and Discovery Lab
    https://eng.ox.ac.uk/jobs/job-detail?vacancyID=187853
    University of Oxford, Department of Engineering Science (BOLD Lab, with UCL and Imperial College London) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Salary on Oxford Grade 10R, GBP 65,336 to GBP 84,663 per year, with the posting noting that further salary options are being explored. Benefits include associate membership at Reuben College, 38 days annual leave, pension scheme, childcare services, and travel expenses for stakeholder and conference visits. Fellows also get access to substantial compute: 3 million GPU hours on Isambard for the first 18 months, with the lab working towards 5,000 H100-equivalents in total across industry and government support. No application fee.
  • This is Gender Regional Curatorial Fellowship 2026
    https://thisisgender.global5050.org/regional-curatorial-fellowship/
    This is Gender (Global 50/50) · deadline 22 Sep 2026 · Stipend of up to GBP 3,000 for the seven-month part-time fellowship. No application fee.
  • 2027 d/p Curator Support Open Call (Seoul)
    https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1iSjEuCjay7DhL1AF1NCePu-5RV3t_10WT0CNcjNNJy8/preview
    d/p, sponsored by NakwonSangga · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Curatorial grant of KRW 4,000,000 (including tax) per selected curator or team, plus use of d/p's approximately 187 square metre exhibition space for a five-week exhibition and curatorial collaboration with the d/p team. Approximately two curators or teams are selected. No application fee.

item.title: 8 new grants - week of 17 Aug 2026

For a development research phase, up to 70% of variable costs capped at EUR 15,000, covering travel, accommodation and presentation costs.     https://www.fondsbjp.nl/subsidies/
    Fonds Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten (Fonds BJP) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 19,200 for six months of work on a single reporting dossier. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Heritage Innovation (September 2026 round)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/heritage-innovation/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline 17 Sep 2026 · Projects: up to 40% of variable project-related costs, with a minimum project budget of EUR 25,000. Research tracks: up to 70% of costs, capped at EUR 15,000, with no minimum budget. No application fee.
  • American Academy in Berlin: Berlin Prize Fellowship 2027-28
    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/
    American Academy in Berlin · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 5,000, plus roundtrip airfare, accommodation at or near the Hans Arnhold Center, partial board, in-house library services and professional networking opportunities. Roughly two dozen fellowships awarded each year. No application fee.
  • Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.
  • La Résidence du Festival de Cannes (Cinéma de Demain): Screenwriting Residency in Paris
    https://cinemadedemain.festival-cannes.com/en/take-part/register-to-the-residence/
    Festival de Cannes (Cinéma de Demain / La Résidence) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Fully supported: a place of residence in central Paris, a personalised script-writing programme, and a collective programme of forums with film industry professionals. Directors present at the CNC pavilion in Cannes, where the CNC awards a EUR 5,000 grant to one director per session. Free to apply.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.

    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 30,000 per grant. No application fee.
  • Kone Foundation: Annual Grant Call (2026)
    https://koneensaatio.fi/en/grants/grantapplicants/criteria-for-applying/
    Kone Foundation / Koneen Saatio (Finland) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Artistic groups and organisations up to EUR 250,000; research groups typically EUR 200,000 to 500,000. Minimum project duration six months for individual applicants and one month for groups; maximum four consecutive years for the same project. No co-financing requirement stated. No application fee. No retroactive funding.
  • Fonds Podiumkunsten: Foreign Performances or Concerts in the Netherlands (round 4, 2026)
    https://fondspodiumkunsten.nl/subsidies/buitenlandse-voorstellingen-of-concerten-in-nederland
    Fonds Podiumkunsten (Performing Arts Fund NL) · deadline 23 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 25,000 per production, capped at EUR 75,000 for an applicant presenting multiple productions. Calculated on travel and transport costs of the foreign artists and their production only. EUR 267,500 available per round shared across this scheme and two sibling internationalisation schemes. Fees, venue and production costs stay with the applicant. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Utrecht: Project Subsidy Culture (Projectsubsidie Cultuur, round 3 2026)
    https://loket.digitaal.utrecht.nl/nl/producten/projectsubsidie-cultuur-aanvragen
    Gemeente Utrecht (Municipality of Utrecht) · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Category A: EUR 1,000 to 5,000. Category B: EUR 5,000 to 20,000. No fixed co-financing percentage, but a budget and coverage plan is mandatory. eHerkenning purchase costs may be included in the budget and are reimbursed if awarded. No application fee.
  • BNG Cultuurfonds: Project Grants (round closing September 2026)
    https://www.bngbank.nl/bng-cultuurfonds/projectsubsidies
    Stichting BNG Cultuurfonds (BNG Bank) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 minimum to EUR 15,000 maximum. The request must represent 5 to 35 percent of total project funding, so at least 65 percent co-financing is required. The fund is never the sole financier, and place-specific projects require at least one local or regional co-financier. No application fee.
  • Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven: Project Subsidy (Projecten, 2027 round 1)
    https://cultuureindhoven.nl/informatie-over-subsidies-2025-2028/
    Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 35,000 per application and maximum 80 percent of eligible costs, so at least 20 percent co-financing is required. No application fee.
  • Ernst von Siemens Musikstiftung: Project Funding (October 2026 round)
    https://evs-musikstiftung.ch/en/project-funding/application/
    Ernst von Siemens Musikstiftung · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · No published minimum or maximum. Primarily covers artistic costs, not overheads. The Foundation explicitly will not fully fund a project, and requires at least one other institution to participate financially at a level similar to the amount requested, functioning as a de facto 1:1 match. No application fee.
  • Alicia Patterson Fellowship 2027 (Fund for Investigative Journalism)
    https://investigate.submittable.com/submit/355041/alicia-patterson-fellowship-2027
    Fund for Investigative Journalism (Alicia Patterson Foundation program) · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · $40,000 (12-month fellowship) or $20,000 (6-month fellowship), paid monthly; covers living and reporting costs

Three finalists receive mentorship, fiscal sponsorship, consideration for the Panavision New Filmmaker Program, and $500 off Athos production insurance.     https://slamdance.com/festival-submit/

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• CRP Research Fellowship Programme 2026
    https://www2.fundsforngos.org/innovation/call-for-applications-crp-research-fellowship-programme/
    CRP Research Fellowship Programme · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Travel lump-sum allowance plus return economy airfare, a weekly subsistence allowance of EUR 600 or EUR 650 (depending on host-country cost of living), and a fixed EUR 165 terminal allowance. Not covered: insurance, visa fees, lab/bench fees, family travel, and personal or dependents' costs.

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 20 Apr 2026
item.description:
• MacDowell Fellowship
    https://www.macdowell.org/apply/apply-for-fellowship
    MacDowell · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · No residency fee; need-based stipends and travel reimbursement available; ~300 fellowships/year
  • Fund for Investigative Journalism (FIJ) Grants
    https://fij.org/apply-for-a-grant/
    Fund for Investigative Journalism · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Up to $10,000 (regular) or $1,000 to $2,500 (seed)
  • Impulse and In-Depth Scheme (I&V) for Rotterdam Visual Artists
    https://en.artoffice.info/regeling/iv/
    CBK Rotterdam / Art Office · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · Up to €7,500 (time compensation; fee depends on project duration)
